invariants: Public registration always creates a tourist
Sessions use an HttpOnly cookie and unsafe requests require CSRF
Inactive users and expired sessions cannot access protected routes
Only an administrator can create staff accounts or change roles
Changing a password, role, or status revokes affected sessions
Only the administrator creates agencies and assigns managers
An agency manager belongs to at most one agency
The administrator cannot edit minor policy or payment methods
Only the assigned agency manager edits its commercial policy
QR and banking data are not exposed in the public agency representation
Only the administrator creates attractions and assigns one manager
An attraction manager can manage multiple assigned attractions only
The public catalog exposes only active published attractions
Schedules and seasons use structured values rather than free text
Favorites are private to their tourist owner
The public home never requires a session
Home content comes only from published and currently available catalog data
Personal dashboard counters are scoped to the authenticated tourist or manager
The administrator dashboard contains global counts but no personal dashboard
Protected dashboard routes reject anonymous and cross-role access
Only published packages from active and published agencies appear in the public catalog
A tourist selects a generated departure identifier and never submits a free-form date
Available capacity excludes held and confirmed capacity while only confirmed capacity counts toward the minimum
Purchase availability requires an open window, a future departure, a permitted state, and remaining capacity
Only the assigned agency manager can change or cancel a departure
Manual departure exceptions survive later schedule regeneration
A purchase always references an existing generated departure and never accepts a free-form date
Submitting proof atomically discounts capacity into held capacity without counting it toward the minimum
Confirming payment atomically moves capacity from held to confirmed and updates the departure minimum state
Minors below the agency minimum age are recorded but neither pay nor consume capacity
Foreign surcharge applies to every foreign participant who pays
A correction request preserves held capacity while a refund request releases it
Concurrent attempts for the last seat create at most one purchase
Only the tourist owner and the assigned agency manager can see a purchase and its proof
Reaching the booking close below the minimum only marks the departure for review and never starts refunds without agency confirmation
A valid tourist cancellation atomically releases held or confirmed capacity and starts a full refund
A late or policy-disabled cancellation preserves the purchase and its capacity
Every refund deadline is exactly 72 hours after the refund request
A refund can be completed only after the tourist provides a valid QR or bank destination and the agency uploads proof of at most 5 MB
Only the purchase owner and assigned agency manager can read refund QR and proof images
Only the assigned agency manager can confirm a minimum shortfall or complete its refunds
